figures.caption: Figure 1: Three-level reverse-phi evaluation with a fixed 3.944◦ displacement per update. Solid: fraction of flyvis models meeting the reversal criterion; dashed: fraction passing the matched standard control (legend: “standard sanity”).

Figure 2: Adversarial margins. (a) Minimal reversing ℓ∞ perturbation divided by contrast (median and interquartile range). (b) Attack advantage over a naive counter-moving grating; the panel labels ϵ∗ as ϵPGD.

Table 3: Attribution against exhaustive single-connection ground truth. Zero→held-out and zero→counterfactual apply the zero-aligned score to a different ground truth; zero→zero and the remaining rows match attribution and intervention semantics. Spearman is the mean full-vector correlation across models 000–009 for each behaviour; AUROC (ground-truth top 20) and precision@20 are means over the 20 model–behaviour pairs.

Figure 3: Attribution agreement averaged over the 20 model–behaviour pairs. (a) Full-vector Spearman and (b) AUROC for the ground-truth top 20, for zero-aligned and intervention-matched IG and first-order EAP. The zero→zero bars show the matched zero-ablation case for reference.

Table 5: Matched T4/T5-criterion results for the six models in which the cell-type search reaches Ftun ≥ 6. “Source types retained” counts added source types with at least one outgoing connection left after pruning.

Table 6: Directional predictions and analysis gates recorded in scripts before execution. Results over all 50 models use the same criteria as the ten-model results. Three entries (population-vector readout, timestep check, anatomical set without lamina) are reported only here; predictions about analyses outside this paper are omitted.
Table 7: Reversal counts for the two-level contrast-inverting grating → the three-level reverse-phi stimulus, by velocity (◦/s). CNN denominators are five checkpoints per architecture.

Figure 5: Decoder-level connection sufficiency. Mean faithful clips F (of 8) when only k connections are kept, over 10 models and two ranking stimuli. (a) Complement zero-ablated. (b) Complement replaced by same-stimulus clean mean currents; the apparently small sets are leakage-prone and mostly lack an inputto-output path. Legend: “true single-edge ranking” is the ranking by true single-connection effect; “greedy (true ablation)” is greedy forward selection evaluated by direct intervention.

Table 9: Stationary patterns. Top: sawtooth gradients (Agrochao et al., 2020), number of models meeting the direction and magnitude criterion (left-to-right / right-to-left polarity) and median response relative to a moving grating. Bottom: four-level peripheral-drift sequence (black, dark grey, white, light grey; Conway et al., 2005), number of models reporting the ordering-predicted direction (forward / reverse ordering) in the sustained window, by spatial period in ommatidia.

Figure 6: Forward search under the matched T4/T5 tuning criterion in models 000–009. (a) Tuning score after 15 additions for cell-type and single-connection searches. (b) Connection-search scores at 15, 30 and 60 additions; each colored trajectory is one model and overlapping trajectories coincide. The horizontal line marks Ftun ≥ 6.
